reasoningGenerationControls.label: Reasoning effort

options.label: Low
options.description: Lowest token use and latency, with less depth on difficult work.

options.label: Medium
options.description: Balanced capability, speed, and output-token usage.

options.label: High
options.description: Provider default for strong reasoning and tool use.

options.label: X-high
options.description: Extended capability for long-running coding and agentic work.

options.label: Max
options.description: Maximum capability without a token-efficiency constraint.

reasoningGenerationControls.description: Controls total response effort, including reasoning, answer text, and tool calls. Lower levels reduce latency and cost; higher levels spend more tokens for difficult work.
